## SQL query for QC data

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

# enable and register the REGEXP function in the SQLite connection
initExtension(con, extension = "regexp")

# SQL query for intra- and inter-assay precision data
query.L1 <- "SELECT TestName, SampleID, CAST(DoseResult AS FLOAT) AS DoseResult, DoseUnit
                  FROM DxIvalData
                  WHERE TestName = 'Cortisol' 
                    AND SampleID REGEXP '[a-zA-Z]+1_\\d'
                    AND DoseUnit IS NOT NULL;"

query.L2 <- "SELECT TestName, SampleID, CAST(DoseResult AS FLOAT) AS DoseResult, DoseUnit
                  FROM DxIvalData
                  WHERE TestName = 'Myoglobin' 
                    AND SampleID REGEXP '[a-zA-Z]+2_\\d'
                    AND DoseUnit IS NOT NULL;"

# execute the query
prc.L1.data <- dbGetQuery(con, query.L1)
prc.L2.data <- dbGetQuery(con, query.L2)

```

```{r CLSIEP15 table, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# building the CLSIEP15 table
cort.long <- data.frame(
  rep = rep(1:5, each = 5),
  name = prc.L1.data$SampleID[1:25],
  value = prc.L1.data$DoseResult[1:25]
)

library(CLSIEP15)
prc.data.L1 <- calculate_aov_infos(cort.long)

```
